paras: Liolaemus buergeri, also known commonly as Buerger's tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family  Liolaemidae. The species is native to Argentina and Chile.
The specific name, buergeri, is in honor of German explorer Otto Bürger (born 1865), who collected natural history specimens in South America.
In Argentina L. buergeri is found in Mendoza Province and Neuquén Province. In Chile it is found in Curicó Province and Talca Province.
The preferred natural habitat of L. buergeri is shrubland with rocky areas, at altitudes of 1,500–3,000 m (4,900–9,800 ft).
